It used to be a quick and simple to add recent food(s) to a breakfast, lunch, dinner or snacks period but the recents is now hidden behind search and an app dev with too much time on their hands, felt selecting recent foods could be made more annoying by adding animations as you’re selecting items. Adding common recents went from quick and simple to tedious.

reviews.title: The new search/add food UI is awful
reviews.text: I have absolutely loved this app for many years. I’ve lost a lot of weight and basically turned my life around, with this app playing a huge part in that journey. Very recently they changed how you search and add food, though. It used to be so quick and easy I legitimately bragged on it to any of my friends who mentioned wanting to lose weight and track calories on an app, and would recommend this one. Now? No. It’s so bad. I hate having to bring up that menu, and then hunt through options to find search (the bright yellow Smart Assistant button always makes my eyes dart to it first, I’m sure this was intended…) and then add 1 thing at a time from search. Please please add an option to swap between the new or the old UI for adding food or something. You had basically the perfect food logging app before. I would really rather stay with my beloved Fatsecret, but I’m trying out different food logging apps for the first time in over 5 years because of how clunky this update has made things.

reviews.text: The service just wants money, so they keep cutting free features and pushing paid ones. For example, just recently, they removed the ability to copy a consumed food item from a followed user's calendar via the website. Why? Because they want me to pay for Premium, where this feature is available in the app.

reviews.title: Database is wrong
reviews.text:
Fed up of scanning a barcode and seeing that the app is out by hundreds of calories, macros out by upto 60%.

The app lets you edit the information if it’s inaccurate, but then the next day it’s still showing wrong.

reviews.title: Poor food identification
reviews.text: I installed this app and up on installation I went through all the unnecessary registrations, data sharing and nickname creation. I find these all unnecessary and unrelated to my scope. I mainly required an application that scans the barcode of my foods and ads the calories to my daily diary. This doesn’t work. When I asked to scan a barcode, it immediately takes a picture of the product and ends up non-recognising it. I have tried this with numerous foods available in all UK supermarkets and nothing. I have deleted the app.

reviews.title: Sex assigned at birth?
reviews.text:
Is this app serious? It asks my biological sex assigned at birth. Biological sex is not something assigned. 

Stop pandering to people. I need a serious app based on science!
